name: DFF (Decomposing NeRF for Editing Via Feature Field Distillation)
definition: A method that enables 3D semantic segmentation and editable novel-view synthesis by distilling features from a 2D teacher network (LSeg or DINO) into a neural radiance field, allowing decomposition of scenes into semantic regions.
summary: DFF distills 2D features into NeRFs for zero-shot 3D editing, avoiding retraining by decoupling semantics from low-level factors.
